sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: railroad cautions, route markers and mile posts, work zones and pavement markings
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (AZ-WORKZONE-ETWO-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may teach national pavement markings without Arizona's statewide mile posts or its doubled work-zone fines; an Arizona-specific work-zone and mile-post drill could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.
